Load Gemma text encoder — LTX-2's checkpoint does not bundle a CLIP/text-encoder at all (confirmed live: CheckpointLoaderSimple's clip output is None). Needs the FULL google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized HF repo (config.json + tokenizer files + sharded weights) in its own subfolder under models/text_encoders/, per gemma_encoder.py::gemma_model_dir() which requires a config.json next to whichever shard is selected here — a single repackaged .safetensors file (no config/tokenizer) is NOT sufficient, confirmed live via 'No config.json found for the selected Gemma model'. See deploy/README.md step 4 for the exact download command.
